name: fl_git_guardrails
description: Git guardrails and safety policy enforcer. Scans proposed git commands or sets up hooks to intercept and block destructive operations (push --force, reset --hard, clean -fd, branch -D, unauthorized main checkout) preserving repository integrity.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'validate_command' (default, checks if a git command is safe or destructive) or 'install_hook' (installs git safety interceptor hook in target repo).

git_command.description: The command string to evaluate for destructive operations.

repo_path.description: Path to target repository. Defaults to current directory ('.').

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
